key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces the Annexes of Directive 70/156/EEC with consolidated text on vehicle EC type-approval.
Applies the amended Directive only to M1 vehicles with internal combustion engines.
Member States must transpose by 1 July 2002 and apply from that date.
Annexes set information documents, certificates of conformity and approval numbering.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive 2001/116/EC adapts Directive 70/156/EEC on motor vehicle type-approval to technical progress, replacing its Annexes with consolidated text covering information documents, certificates of conformity and numbering for EC type-approval. It contains no AI or robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2001/116/EC of 20 December 2001 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 70/156/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
